_doc: Prose voice contract for NFRI essays — not rendered directly; informs manifesto.json, argument.json, analysis.json edits. Blend: the market-essay register (index-as-product), Katherine Boyle / a16z American Dynamism (physical-world seriousness), ARC Reindustrialise (capacity, energy, builders).
principles: Open with a physical-world claim — the grid, the queue, the connection agreement — not a product feature.
Lead with a manifesto line when the section is thesis-level: We [verb] the [physical noun].
Name the builder class: underwriters, carriers, asset operators who must carry what policy is piling on.
Treat the dataset as the artifact; the chart is the argument (market essay).
Separate root cause from symptom — reindustrialisation fails without affordable, firm-enough power (ARC).
Number the industrial agenda when arguing policy — reform, electrons, cover, aggregation, capital.
Bold thesis, measured evidence — every number cited or flagged PROVISIONAL; eval gate is part of the voice.
Alternate short declarative sentences with one longer sentence carrying the machinery.
Name the strongest objection, then answer it.
Close on a turn the reader could not have started with — never a summary.

patterns.kicker: Two to four words, uppercase in render — MANIFESTO, THE STACK, THE THESIS.
patterns.opening: One sentence reframing the dominant question (damage → interruption; hazard → preparedness).
patterns.manifesto_line: We [verb] the [physical noun] — parallel to stewardship declarations; one line, serif, load-bearing.
patterns.five_steps: Numbered stack (.01–.05) when linking reindustrialisation to insurable/peril mechanics.
patterns.index_move: Like [index name] for [population]: pick the unscored field, ship the dataset, let the viz argue.
patterns.boyle_move: Physical-world builders need [registers / measurement / honesty] — not another dashboard.
patterns.eval_move: PROVISIONAL is epistemic hygiene — the gate runs on every build, not a footnote.
